properties.formula: 100 × G × (0.25S + 0.20D + 0.10E + 0.15I + 0.10T) / 0.80  — the documented RANKING.md formula with the regional-evidence term R removed and the remaining weights rescaled to sum to 1
properties.formula_check: The documented full formula reproduces every stored score within 0.08 points.
properties.caveat: Every Menifee crossing is on a combined-unit quadrangle (VERIFIED TARGET CONTACT, combined-unit top): the true Nada top sits a few feet to ~10 m below the mapped line. Not field-checked. Not part of the ranked 120.
